workItem: Implement SH-02.6 frontend degraded-mode and version-skew recovery with bounded safe-request retry, feature-local recovery, explicit stale-data opt-in, accessible connectivity state and session-preserving rehydration.
workItemDE: SH-02.6 Frontend-Degraded-Mode und Version-Skew-Recovery mit begrenztem Safe-Request-Retry, feature-lokaler Recovery, explizitem Stale-Data-Opt-in, zugänglichem Connectivity-State und session-erhaltender Rehydration implementieren.
priorityReason: After SH-02.3 and the merged backend/worker recovery slices, frontend recovery must converge without infinite reloads, unsafe mutation retries, stale financial-value fabrication or destructive session resets.
frontendParticipation: CAPITAL-AI-FE cross-cutting presentation/recovery only; no productive PVC ownership.
releaseCondition: Release on Human/CODEOWNER merge, PR close, supersession or abandonment; automation has no merge authority.
scopeNote: No source is permitted to use Last-Known-Good data unless it explicitly opts into a bounded stale-data policy. Mutation requests are never automatically retried. Version-skew recovery updates only reliability session state and reloads the document at most once per observed deployment transition; Supabase/auth persistent session storage is not cleared.
implementationBoundary: Global reliability is event-driven and presentation-only. Feature remount preserves persistent auth/session state. Generic retries are GET/HEAD-only. LKG is deny-by-default and requires explicit bounded source opt-in.
